title: Investigate a cheap way to surface a stale marketplace clone to consumers
summary: Reusable lesson from OMARK-21's correction (2026-09-08): shipping a plugin release does not deliver it. A consumer's local 'opum' marketplace clone (~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/opum) is a separate cache with its own refresh step; nothing in the restart path reports that the cache is behind upstream dev, and sessions come up looking entirely healthy on the old build. This is the same shape as opum-agent's OPAG-56 finding that shipping a replacement hook is not rewiring a consumer. Investigate whether this repo can make a stale-clone consumer visible cheaply -- for example a documented pre-restart check consumers can run, a version marker a session hook could compare against installed plugin versions, or similar. The acceptable outcome includes 'no cheap mechanism exists, document the manual refresh step instead' -- the point is to record the finding either way, not to guarantee a build.
plan: Verify claude plugin marketplace list/update --help and JSON output for any staleness signal
Document the manual refresh command for consumers if no automatic mechanism exists
implementationNotes: Investigated the CLI surface directly: 'claude plugin marketplace list --json' returns only {name, source, repo, installLocation} for each configured marketplace -- no version, commit SHA, or last-synced timestamp (verified by running it). 'claude plugin marketplace update [name]' is the only refresh mechanism, and it is not automatic. Nothing in opum-marketplace's own content executes inside a consumer's session (it is a static index -- marketplace.json plus READMEs, no hooks), so this repository has no way to push a staleness signal into a session even in principle; a stale-clone detector would have to live in the Claude Code CLI itself (out of this repo's scope) or in a consumer's own session tooling (opum-workflow's hooks already solve the adjacent but different problem of cross-version drift on an already-refreshed install, per OFLE-52/OFLE-71 -- that is not this gap).

Decision: no cheap mechanism exists from this repository's own scope. Documented the manual refresh step (/plugin marketplace update opum) in README.md's new 'Staying current' section, matching the acceptable outcome this task named up front.
finalSummary: Per PR #130 (checks green on SHA 38631f0 -- Tracker integrity/check-manifests/lore check all completed/success): verified claude plugin marketplace list --json exposes no version/commit/sync-time field and nothing in this repo executes inside a consumer session, so no cheap automatic staleness signal is possible from this repo's scope. Documented the manual /plugin marketplace update opum refresh in README.md's new 'Staying current' section, per the task's own acceptable-outcome framing.
